You said:
Which iPhone calendar apps have Home Screen widgets for upcoming appointments and weather? Distinguish a Home Screen widget, a Lock Screen widget and a Live Activity, and cite current official product sources.
ChatGPT said:

As of October 2026, several iPhone calendar apps offer Home Screen widgets showing upcoming appointments and weather. The important distinction is whether an app shows both in the same widget, offers separate widgets, or only displays weather inside the calendar app.

For your specific requirement, Fantastical, Cloud Calendars, and easyDays are worth considering first. Apple's built-in Calendar and Weather apps are also a good free solution if two separate widgets are acceptable.

1. Home Screen widget vs. Lock Screen widget vs. Live Activity

Feature

	

Where it appears

	

What it does




Home Screen widget

	

Among your app icons

	

Displays your upcoming appointments, weather forecast, or both, without opening the app




Lock Screen widget

	

Above or below the clock on the locked screen

	

Shows compact information such as your next appointment or current temperature




Live Activity

	

Lock Screen and, on supported iPhones, Dynamic Island

	

Tracks an ongoing or time-sensitive activity, such as a delivery, journey, or countdown

These are three different iOS features. An app advertising Lock Screen widgets or Live Activities does not necessarily provide a Home Screen widget.

Apple confirms that Home Screen widgets can display weather and calendar events, while Live Activities are designed for tracking the progress of activities.

To install a Home Screen widget, long-press an empty area of the Home Screen, tap Edit → Add Widget, choose the calendar app, select a size, and tap Add Widget. For Fantastical, long-press the added widget and select Edit Widget to check the weather setting.
